title: About Taleborn…
author: Kagei_Kat
selftext: Taleborn is an AI based Character creation/Storytelling IOS Android app as far as my experience goes with it. This is a reflection of my time playing it, and keep in mind that I’m still playing this game. First things first, what astounds me is the amazing detail behind the character creation, you simply input a description and the game can create a set of four skills to start, as well as an image for your hero you create. I love the detail when you first begin playing against other players as well, the stories are always tense, and it’s never always a sure fire win. Upon my time playing, there are some things that I wish could be added. Keep in mind I have a perfectionist personality, even though we are dealing with AI, it’s hard to create characters with skills that truly reflect the intentions behind them. The space limited to just 500 character makes it incredibly difficult to not only trap appearance, but the character’s whole personality, as I find myself in a constant struggle for space to find the small details. Aside from this, the new dungeon feature has dropped, and although I’ve heard it is sure to be buggy, I also can’t help but notice that the feature requires two characters to have been made. I don’t know the reasoning behind it, and I’m sure there is some good reasoning for it, it just leaves a few blanks to fill in as it seems to be a good way to fuel up the in game currency instead of playing up to 40 matches with a character to get only 5 pieces of the in game currency. The three pieces daily does tend to help, but that doesn’t really help motivate with engaging with your characters. The fights are awesome, and that arises my last question, why not allow characters to use all four of their skills at once? I’m not tech savvy or anything that way, but I’m kind of voicing my opinion out loud here as I’d love to see some answers that I’ve had on my mind for now. With all four skills active, in my head, that would allow for more diverse interactions between characters. I apologize if I seem stupid for any of these comments I made here, I’m incredibly oblivious when it comes to knowledge about Ai and game development, I’m sure everything has a reason and why, but I would appreciate interacting with the creator, and learning why everything works the way it does, pose questions to help expand my knowledge so to say. So feel free to challenge me with questions as well, and I’ll answer to the best of my ability when I can find the time to do so. Thank you for taking the time to read this post, I hope that if you’ve made this far, you’ll have received my good intentions behind these questions as an academic mind that seeks understanding. You’ll also find a link to the game this review is about in the URL at the top of this post. This will redirect you to the Apple Store, so I apologize if this inconveniences any one of any different platforms.
